name: Trader's Co-Pilot
tagline: An MCP server giving AI agents Solana trading tools with signals, risk scoring and front-running protection.
problem: Retail crypto traders lose money and suffer front-running attacks, the team says.
solution: Fourteen MCP tools for signals, portfolio health, sentiment, DeFi strategy and attack-pattern detection.
demo_moment: Team-described: an agent requests a signal and a risk check.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Creative Solana MCP” among 122 submissions.

lessons: Wrap a domain's tools for agents and the sponsor's platform becomes the backbone.
